stem: Containers are draining into trays that retain standing water around their bases after irrigation. What is the strongest corrective action?
choices: Increase event volume so more solution moves through the containers and displaces the standing drainage water
Restore free drainage and prevent prolonged contact with standing water before changing the nutrient recipe
Raise fertilizer EC so roots receive more ions while the lower portion of the container remains saturated
Reduce canopy airflow so transpiration slows and the crop uses less water while trays remain partially filled
rationale: Standing drainage water can interfere with normal drainage and keep the lower root zone excessively wet. Restoring free drainage addresses the root-zone physical condition before unrelated nutrient changes are made.
